provenance: hand-labeled 2026-07-16 by eval author from review texts; a GT consensus theme requires >=2 reviewers raising substantially the same issue
matching_rule_for_checker: a SUT theme matches a GT item if it contains >=2 of core_ids; optional_ids neither reward nor penalize

items.summary: Proxy metrics (SRP/SCH) are never validated in a real expert-offloading system: no end-to-end evaluation, no implementation, no throughput measurements.
Architecture-level conclusions (MoE-every-layer, no shared experts => higher consistency) rest on correlations across 20 heterogeneous models; no controlled ablation on a fixed backbone.
Metric exposition and figures are hard to parse: SRP/SCH need intuitive/visual explanation, figures 2-6 too small, notation overloaded (rho).
